## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the relevant System_Plan part and decision IDs.

## Validation

List the checks actually run, results and any gaps. Include authorization and integration checks when affected.

## Data and deployment

Describe migrations, configuration, rollback needs and campus-network impact, or state that none apply. Keep secrets and client data out of the PR.

## Documentation

Update the relevant plan/index and record unresolved issues or measured optimization opportunities.
